en:
<CLT=cltMIND>I headed to the pool. My heart's safety
was off, and I was going in guns blazing.

<CLT=cltMIND>What an incredible sight to behold!
My fantasy, shining like a supernova!

Nyahaha! They're so big, Tsumugi!
Do you mind if I touch them?

What? I mean...it's embarrassing
if you touch them...

It would just be a waste of magic to grow 
them that big anyway...

Don't worry! They're nicely shaped!
Beauty is way better than size anyway!!!

<CLT=cltMIND>So this is what Angie was planning...
a party for the student council.

<CLT=cltMIND>Anyway...I saw it. I then immediately
questioned the morality of my actions.

<CLT=cltMIND>I just have to keep quiet...
Keep it inside, keep it together!
